notes: Base image is the accepted xorder php-browser 8.4-trixie v1.2.3 resource. The separately pinned Node overlay remains the original 1.2.4-record selection.
Chrome for Testing is added because chrome-devtools-mcp officially supports Google Chrome and Chrome for Testing only; Debian Chromium from the base remains for Panther.
Chrome 157 satisfies chrome-devtools-mcp autoConnect (144+) and the WebMCP tool category (150+ with --enable-features=WebMCP).
The CfT index publishes no sha256; docker/identity.py records the installed binary hash.
xorder release groups: adopt the downstream support check before 2026-11-11 08:00 UTC if this base stays in use.
CI adopts accepted weekly-2026-11-02 php-browser 1.2.3: the original 1.2.4 digest was not in an accepted release group at qualification. Owned Chrome for Testing remains separately pinned.

mago.source: Same version mago-serena_v2-poc pins (upstream rev 46df50c96d93d0ac3655c116c375574277cf0b30). Hash computed from the downloaded asset on 2026-11-09; the installer script verifies attestation with gh, which this build does not.
mago.baseline: The hash-pinned release binary is installed as mago-baseline. Unlike the PoC, the baseline is the upstream release build, not a local unpatched build of the same revision.

sdk.note: Same source revision as the executable; packaged vendor/bin/mago is not invoked. Mago 1.59 uses MANA 2.2 and is incompatible with this pin.
